positiveEvidence.finding: The official Interparking EMOBITALY surface states direct/ad-hoc charging is managed by EMOBITALY, tariff is 0.58 EUR/kWh VAT included, and a fixed start fee applies with minimum 0.50 EUR and maximum 1.40 EUR VAT included. It also states each socket is Type 2 up to 22 kW and roaming-provider pricing is separate.
EMOBITALY confirms point owners can independently set initial, energy and time tariff components; therefore no network-wide EMO price may be inferred from one subnetwork.
Current PUN-derived station data maps Isola Nova del Tronchetto 33/m, Venezia to EMOBITALY and exposes EVSE including IT*EMO*E1013 through IT*EMO*E1028 among the station inventory.
Interparking Tronchetto is independently mapped to sixteen Type-2 22 kW EVSE IT*EMO*E1013 through IT*EMO*E1028. This source is corroboration only and is not used as tariff authority.

coveredSubpopulationCandidate.site: Interparking Tronchetto, Isola Nova del Tronchetto 33/m, Venezia
coveredSubpopulationCandidate.reason: Energy component is first-party and exact for the Interparking surface, but the official page exposes only a range for the fixed start fee. The project requires exact fixed-fee treatment for deterministic ranking; no fee value may be guessed or averaged.

negativeOrBlockedEvidence: No exact per-EVSE/per-site activation fee within the official 0.50-1.40 EUR range was exposed on indexed first-party surfaces.
Current generic EMOBITALY pages confirm owner-defined station pricing, so 0.58 EUR/kWh must not be transposed outside the proven Interparking scope.
Third-party/PUN-derived prices such as 0.48 EUR/kWh plus 1.14 EUR activation are retained only as discovery/corroboration until matched to a first-party direct tariff surface.
changes.decision: Preserve the Interparking 0.58 EUR/kWh direct energy tariff and exact Tronchetto EVSE candidate mapping, but keep all sixteen rows fail-closed because the fixed start fee is only given as a range. Do not promote an EMOBITALY network-wide tariff.
